content.title: About
content.content: The Chicken Fillet Wrap Sandwich, grilled, is a fast‑food item featuring tender grilled chicken fillet wrapped in a soft wheat tortilla together with vegetables and sauce. It is a convenient, protein‑rich meal popular in chain restaurants.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The sandwich is often sold as part of a combo with fries and a drink.
The chicken fillet is usually marinated in spices and lemon juice before grilling, giving it a fragrant flavor.
The wrap format allows the sandwich to be eaten without utensils.
In some regions the recipe includes fresh lettuce, tomato and a yogurt‑based sauce for a lighter taste.
Grilling retains more protein and reduces added fat compared with deep‑frying.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Grilled chicken provides high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: Grilling reduces added fat, making the sandwich a more diet‑friendly option.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Chicken supplies niacin, vitamin B6 and B12, which support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: It contains phosphorus, selenium and zinc, important for bones and immune health.

items.title: Fiber from vegetables
items.content: Added lettuce, tomato and cucumber increase dietary fiber, aiding digestion.

items.title: Chicken allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken proteins.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Sauces and seasonings can be high in salt; people with hypertension should watch portion size.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Although lower in fat than fried options, the sandwich still provides calories from the tortilla and sauce.

items.title: Cooking safety
items.content: Undercooked fillet may harbor pathogens; ensure internal temperature reaches 75 °C.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The sandwich is easy to hold in one hand; you may cut it in half for a smaller bite. Add extra sauce or fresh veggies if desired to boost flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Best consumed immediately. If needed, store in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours in an airtight container. Reheat in a microwave or on a grill before serving to restore a slight crisp.
